about: How the no-GNSS analyzer measures each GNSS outage (spec: Flying without GNSS, Performance from the logs). An outage is a stretch with no receiver holding a 3D fix, or GNSS switched off with the GPS-disable switch (a drill). For each it reads the primary estimator core's own solution status (XKF4.SS): when it stopped using GNSS (detection), how long it kept an absolute position (hold), whether it kept a relative one (optical flow or vision), and when it took GNSS back; the failsafes, mode change and source-set switch around it; and, when GNSS returns to an estimator that still claims a position, how far that position had drifted from it, compared as local tracks from one origin. GNSS must come back trustworthy for that: holding its fix for drift.stable_s with an accuracy within drift.hacc_m, and implying no drift faster than drift.max_mps (a jammed receiver's first fix can be kilometres off). Once the estimator gives its position up, the position it logs is a stale value (in SITL it jumped 26 m and stayed), so no drift is read then. The thresholds are the app's starting points, marked uncalibrated.

drift.growth_about: How the drift found when GNSS returned grows with the time flown, to work out when the estimate is landing_tolerance_m off: t = T (tolerance / drift)^(1/p) for an outage of T seconds. With optical flow, vision or body velocity fused, the estimator's velocity is corrected and the position error grows about in step with the time (p = 1), so a drift per minute is given too. On dead reckoning (XKF4.SS bit 18: navigating on the wind alone) nothing corrects the position or the tilt, so an uncorrected gyro bias tilts the estimate further and further, the acceleration error grows with the time and the position error with its cube (p = 3); a drift per minute measured on a short drill would understate a longer flight, so none is given.

sources: libraries/RC_Channel/RC_Channel.h at Copter-4.7.0: AUX_FUNC GPS_DISABLE = 65 (disable GPS for testing) and EKF_SOURCE_SET = 90 (low, middle and high select source sets 1, 2 and 3); every aux-function change is logged as AUXF (function, pos)
libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_Nav_Common.h at Copter-4.7.0: nav_filter_status bits, logged as XKF4.SS: 3 horiz_pos_rel, 4 horiz_pos_abs, 13 using_gps, 18 dead_reckoning

ArduCopter/Parameters.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: FS_DR_ENABLE acts as dead reckoning starts, which happens only when the EKF loses its position and velocity sources and relies on wind estimates (multirotor drag fusion); FS_DR_TIMEOUT (default 30 s) is how long dead reckoning is allowed before the EKF failsafe

Local SITL flights at Copter-4.7.0, LOITER at 15 m: with GNSS switched off (aux 65) or the simulated receiver disabled, the estimator stopped using GNSS about 4 s later and gave up its absolute position about 7 s after the loss; the EKF failsafe then landed the aircraft, 26 m from its estimate in a 6 m/s wind. On optical flow and a rangefinder (source set 2) it kept a relative position through a 30 s drill, within 1.3 m of GNSS when it returned

https://discuss.ardupilot.org/t/dead-reckoning-stops-early-due-to-ekf-failsafe/130207: a multirotor with no absolute position source estimates its position for only about 30 s (spec: Dead-reckoning range)

libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_Control.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, updateFilterStatus: horiz_pos_rel (bit 3) is set while navigating on optical flow, body velocity or the wind alike, horiz_pos_abs (bit 4) only with GNSS, and dead_reckoning (bit 18) only on the wind with no flow, GNSS or body velocity; AP_NavEKF3_AirDataFusion.cpp 528-535 and AP_NavEKF3_core.cpp 1096-1101: drag fusion corrects only the wind, which is held fixed while dead reckoning (spec: What dead reckoning is in 4.7.0)

Local SITL study at Copter-4.7.0 (16 dead-reckoned flights, 2026-10-27, error against the simulator's true position): the error grew as about the cube of the time since GNSS went (fitted exponent 2.8 to 3.2 over flights of 1.5 to 5.7 minutes). Predicting from the drift at 20, 30, 45 or 60 s when the estimate would be 10 m off gave 0.62 to 1.79 times the true time (median 0.97, 60 cases) with the cube, 0.68 to 3.18 with the square, and 0.27 to 23.7 with a drift per minute

readiness.about: Readiness for flying without GNSS, from the parameters and the platform setup (spec: Flying without GNSS, 'Readiness, from the parameters and the build'). A source set copes without GNSS when one of its horizontal sources is not GNSS; each source names the sensor it needs, whose type parameter must be set. Optical flow navigates only with EK3_FLOW_USE 1 and a downward rangefinder.
sources: libraries/AP_NavEKF/AP_NavEKF_Source.cpp and the EK3_SRCn_* metadata at Copter-4.7.0: POSXY and VELXY 3 are GPS; 4 beacon, 5 optical flow (VELXY), 6 external navigation, 7 wheel encoder (VELXY); POSZ 2 rangefinder; YAW 1 compass, 2 GPS, 3 GPS with compass fallback, 6 external navigation, 8 the GSF yaw estimator (driven by GPS velocity)

libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_OptFlowFusion.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: optical flow is fused for navigation only when EK3_FLOW_USE is 1 (navigation) and the set's VELXY is optical flow; it needs a downward rangefinder for its height above the ground (RNGFNDn_ORIENT 25)

libraries/AP_NavEKF3/AP_NavEKF3_Measurements.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, SampleDragData: drag fusion runs only when EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X or _Y is above 1 or EK3_DRAG_MCOEF above 0.001, and only in builds for boards with more than 1 MB of flash (AP_NavEKF3_feature.h, EK3_FEATURE_DRAG_FUSION); AP_NavEKF3_Control.cpp: the estimator reports dead reckoning only while it navigates on the wind (drag or airspeed)

ArduCopter/events.cpp and Parameters.cpp at Copter-4.7.0: FS_DR_ENABLE acts as dead reckoning starts and FS_DR_TIMEOUT counts from then, so without drag fusion neither ever acts and the EKF failsafe (FS_EKF_ACTION, FS_EKF_THRESH) is what responds

ArduCopter/mode.h at Copter-4.7.0: Stabilize (0), Acro (1), AltHold (2), Sport (13) and FlowHold (22, on optical flow) need no position (requires_position false); aux functions 52, 68, 70 and 71 select Acro, Stabilize, AltHold and FlowHold

ArduCopter/GCS_MAVLink_Copter.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, handle_manual_control_axes: a joystick's MANUAL_CONTROL drives channels 1 to 4 only, so an aux switch on another channel needs a transmitter or an RC override; GCS_Common.cpp: MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET and MAV_CMD_DO_AUX_FUNCTION select a source set or run an aux function from a ground station

https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/master/common/source/docs/common-non-gps-to-gps.rst (GPS / Non-GPS Transitions): source set 1 for GPS, a second set for the non-GPS sensor, a 3-position switch with aux function 90 to change sets, Lua scripts (ahrs-source-gps-optflow.lua) to switch on sensor quality, and the bench test

https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot_wiki/blob/master/copter/source/docs/airspeed-estimation.rst (Windspeed Estimation and Baro Compensation): EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X and _Y are the mass in kg over the frontal and side area in square metres; EK3_DRAG_MCOEF comes from a flight test (accelerating into and across the wind in AltHold, in light wind) and is normally 0.1 to 1.0; then barometer wind compensation (BAROn_WCF_*)
